verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Version-consistent publication and serving safety: all three publication destinations, the same-version gate, non-serving of partial writes, and repair-or-rollback semantics are explicitly represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: Document version lifecycle semantics are missing: the board does not show the unchanged-content bypass, changed-version supersession, or deletion of stale derived records.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board strongly covers the main ingestion-to-publication path, retrieval/reranking/ACL sequence, grounded cited answers, DLQ basics, feedback loop, and safe index-generation promotion. However, several identity-defining operational rules are absent or generalized, especially per-document batch continuation, new/changed/unchanged handling, stale-record cleanup, exact low-confidence triggers, parallel retrieval, and the embedding-model-change rebuild trigger. Weighted credit is 45.0 out of 67.0.
